levels.name: Ad hoc
levels.decision_layer: AI influences decisions with no durable record.
levels.action_layer: Agents run under human credentials; no inventory; actions indistinguishable from employees in every log.

levels.name: Aware
levels.decision_layer: Policies exist and some activity is logged; coverage is partial.
levels.action_layer: Agent activity is known and partially logged; scopes are informal.

levels.name: Defined
levels.decision_layer: The four pillars are standard practice for high-stakes decisions.
levels.action_layer: Agents hold scoped identities; delegation thresholds are written; actions attributable on request.

levels.name: Managed
levels.decision_layer: Controls are tested rather than assumed; audit-ready on demand.
levels.action_layer: Execution boundaries are tested; approvals recorded at grant time; representation monitored.

levels.name: Defensible by default
levels.decision_layer: Decision integrity captured automatically at decision time.
levels.action_layer: Authorization captured at execution time; every action replayable; containment rehearsed.
